protocols.continuation_reason: Preserve the first five transmissions and represent an adapter execution exception as failed CPU evidence before the one registered feedback revision.

artifact_policy.copied: Model requests, native responses, authorization and confirmation receipts, CPU validation records and case results were copied byte-for-byte while preserving the runs-relative layout.
artifact_policy.excluded: Worker stdout/stderr wrappers were excluded because they are not decision evidence and can contain host-specific execution details.
